description: This PHP source file defines the NodeFaq class, which models a FAQ node in the application. It includes methods for retrieving FAQ entries from the database, getting associated images, saving updates, validating data, and fetching related questions. The class interacts with language settings, database queries, and image handling components.

classes.name: NodeFaq
classes.description: Model class representing FAQ nodes with methods for data retrieval, image handling, validation, and related questions.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a NodeFaq instance by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches a list of NodeFaq instances based on filters, pagination, and language.

methods.name: getBySlug
methods.description: Retrieves a NodeFaq instance using a combination of node ID and slug.

methods.name: getBannerHeaderImage
methods.description: Returns an Image object for the banner header image associated with the FAQ.

methods.name: getBannerHeaderImageMd
methods.description: Returns an Image object for the medium-sized banner header image.

methods.name: getBannerHeaderImageSm
methods.description: Returns an Image object for the small-sized banner header image.

methods.name: getBannerHeaderImageXs
methods.description: Returns an Image object for the extra small-sized banner header image.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the NodeFaq instance to the database after validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the data of the NodeFaq instance, checking for required fields.

methods.name: getQuestions
methods.description: Returns a list of questions associated with this FAQ Node.
